reading: Lyric reading (paraphrased): she asks her beloved to spare her arms a moment (embrace), to savour tonight's beauty with his eyes (gaze), not to waste time on idle talk (urgency), then offers her life as a sacrifice and says ruin is certain, he is fire and she is water (fire / duel). The second verse asks him to respect the delicacy of the moment, says a beauty's consent can't be bought (pride) and not to be proud on hollow promises (hollow). The drops are the fire-and-water duel; the last tagline is where the two meet.
